episodes.title: Winter Is Coming
probes: Six orphaned direwolf pups are found in the snow, and one is handed to each child of the northern household.
Across the Narrow Sea, a silver-haired exiled girl is given three fossilized dragon eggs as a wedding gift.
The king's whole travelling party rides north into the snowbound castle, the household lined up in the courtyard to receive them.

episodes.title: The Kingsroad
probes: Daenerys, newly wed, devotes herself to learning how to please Drogo in the marriage bed.

episodes.title: Lord Snow
probes: Ned sits in on the King's Small Council for the first time and learns how deeply the realm is in debt.
Having learned Arya kept the sword Jon gave her, Ned arranges swordsmanship lessons for her in the capital.
In training at the Wall, Jon plainly outmatches the low-born recruits and convicted criminals swinging swords beside him.

episodes.title: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
probes: Jon steps in to shield an awkward, friendless new recruit from the beatings the other Watchmen hand out.
Tyrion breaks his journey south with a stop at Winterfell before continuing on to King's Landing.

episodes.title: A Golden Crown
probes: Bran rides out through the woods on horseback for the first time, trying out his specially built saddle.
Ned sits the Iron Throne in Robert's absence, hearing complaints brought by petitioners from Riverrun.
Robert gathers his party and rides out of the capital for a hunting trip.
Ned tells Arya and Sansa they are being sent back north to Winterfell for their own safety.

episodes.title: You Win or You Die
probes: Jon's new duties have him waiting on Jeor Mormont personally, fetching and serving for the Lord Commander.

episodes.title: The Pointy End
probes: Tyrion and Bronn are ambushed on a mountain road by a band of hill tribesmen.
Dothraki riders sweep through a nearby settlement, roping together captured locals to be sold as slaves.

episodes.title: Baelor
probes: Catelyn goes alone into the hall of a crossing's elderly lord to bargain for passage over his land.
The Stark army halts before a castle guarding a river crossing, waiting while terms are discussed inside.

episodes.title: Fire and Blood
probes: A Night's Watch recruiter shears Arya's hair short so she can pass as a boy among his recruits.

episodes.title: The North Remembers
probes: Daenerys, her people starving and thirsty in a red wasteland, sends three riders out in different directions to scout.
Tyrion turns up in King's Landing to take his seat as acting Hand, which delights Cersei not at all.
Beyond the Wall, the Night's Watch takes shelter in the cramped keep of a man surrounded by his many daughter-wives.

episodes.title: The Night Lands
probes: Theon steps off a boat onto rain-lashed Pyke after nine years away, and his father sneers at his fine Northern clothes.
Sam takes an interest in one of Craster's pregnant wives and begs Jon to help her; Jon wants nothing to do with it.
On a Dragonstone beach, Stannis's smuggler-turned-knight haggles with a boastful pirate captain to bring his fleet over.

episodes.title: What Is Dead May Never Die
probes: Catelyn rides into Renly's sprawling camp of tents and banners, come to talk terms on Robb's behalf.
At Renly's camp, two armored fighters batter each other in a practice duel while onlookers watch from the grass.

episodes.title: Garden of Bones
probes: Catelyn sits mounted in an open field while the two Baratheon brothers ride out to parley with each other.
Littlefinger turns up unannounced at Catelyn's tent in Renly's camp, all courtesy and old familiarity.

episodes.title: The Ghost of Harrenhal
probes: The Night's Watch makes camp at an ancient ringfort on a hilltop beyond the Wall, the Fist of the First Men.
Jeor Mormont hands Jon over to a veteran ranger leading a small party up into the Frostfang mountains.
Jorah argues that Daenerys should win the support of the common people of Westeros rather than buy an army.

episodes.title: The Old Gods and the New
probes: In the aftermath of another battle, Robb walks the field and falls into conversation again with the healer Talisa.
In Qarth, Daenerys keeps pressing for a ship to carry an army west while holding Xaro's attentions at arm's length.
At Harrenhal, Arya lingers over Tywin's table pouring wine while the Lannister commanders pore over their maps.

episodes.title: A Man Without Honor
probes: Cersei sits with Sansa and tells her the only people worth loving are one's own children.
Jon marches his wildling prisoner across the snow, and she taunts him every step of the way.

episodes.title: The Prince of Winterfell
probes: Joffrey berates Varys for knowing so little about where the Stark armies actually are.
Yara turns up at Winterfell and mocks her brother for seizing a castle he has no men to hold.
Jorah agrees to go with Daenerys into the House of the Undying rather than let her enter alone.
Aboard ship as the fleet nears King's Landing, Stannis tells Davos he means to make him Hand of the King.

episodes.title: Blackwater
probes: Sansa, standing beside Joffrey before the fighting starts, urges him to ride out and lead his men himself.
Tyrion, out in the streets beyond the gate, fights on foot among the Gold Cloaks.
Stannis's ships sail by night into the bay below King's Landing while the city's defenders wait on the walls.

episodes.title: Valar Morghulis
probes: Melisandre stands with Stannis over the flames, telling him what glory she can see waiting there for him.

episodes.title: Valar Dohaeris
probes: Margaery leaves her escort behind to walk into a poor district of King's Landing and hand food to orphans.
Ros takes Shae aside for a quiet word, warning her that Littlefinger is not to be trusted.
A scarred Tyrion sits across from his father in his chambers, pressing his claim to Casterly Rock.

episodes.title: Dark Wings, Dark Words
probes: In a garden, Margaery and her sharp-tongued grandmother press Sansa with questions about Joffrey and invite her to Highgarden.
Trudging through the woods with Osha and Hodor, Bran's party comes across a strange brother and sister travelling alone.
Still on foot in open country, Arya, Gendry and Hot Pie are making their way toward Riverrun.

episodes.title: Walk of Punishment
probes: The surviving Night's Watch men trudge back to Craster's Keep, where Gilly is giving birth.

episodes.title: And Now His Watch Is Ended
probes: Arya and Gendry are brought into the Brotherhood's hidden cave and led before the outlaws' leader.
Brienne, still bound alongside a despairing Jaime, urges him to keep hoping rather than give up.
Varys tells Tyrion the story of how he was cut as a boy, then shows him a crated captive in his chambers.

episodes.title: Kissed by Fire
probes: Stannis's young daughter sneaks down to the cells with a book and begins teaching Davos his letters.
Tyrion, buried in the crown's accounts, haggles with Olenna over who should pay for half the royal wedding.
At Harrenhal, a disgraced former maester unwraps and tends the bandaged stump at the end of Jaime's arm.

episodes.title: The Climb
probes: Jon and Ygritte inch up the sheer ice face of the Wall on ropes with Tormund's climbing party.
Travelling north through the woods, Osha and Meera needle each other, and the tension in the camp grows.

episodes.title: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
probes: Tywin climbs the steps to Joffrey in the throne room, brushing aside talk of the Targaryen girl overseas.
Osha, agitated, warns Bran's companions about what she has seen walking beyond the Wall.
Orell watches Jon and Ygritte together as the wildling party travels south, his resentment plain.

episodes.title: Second Sons
probes: At a wedding feast in King's Landing, Tyrion drinks himself loud and sloppy and makes a scene before the hall.
Cersei makes her contempt for Margaery and Loras plain during the wedding celebrations, all icy courtesy and open threat.
Outside Yunkai, Daenerys learns the city has hired a company of sellswords to fight in its defence.
Tywin corners Tyrion after the ceremony and demands he produce a Lannister heir without delay.
Riding through the countryside, the Hound tells Arya plainly what he intends to do with her.

episodes.title: The Rains of Castamere
probes: Bran's group takes shelter inside an abandoned tower while a thunderstorm breaks overhead, and Hodor grows agitated.

episodes.title: Two Swords
probes: Tywin watches a smith melt down a great Valyrian steel blade and reforge the metal into two new swords.
Tyrion rides out to greet a visiting Dornish prince and his paramour, arriving in King's Landing for the royal wedding.
Daenerys watches her dragons squabble over food on a clifftop, now grown to the size of horses.

episodes.title: The Lion and the Rose
probes: In a quiet courtyard, Bronn secretly drills Jaime, forcing him to learn to hold a sword left-handed.
Roose Bolton rides home to the Dreadfort with his new bride, one of Walder Frey's daughters.
The court gathers in King's Landing as Joffrey and Margaery Tyrell are married with great ceremony.

episodes.title: Breaker of Chains
probes: Arya and the Hound are taken in for the night by a peasant farmer and his daughter.
Sam walks Gilly and her baby down to Mole's Town, convinced she will be safer away from Castle Black.
Daenerys stands before the closed gates of Meereen and addresses the slaves inside the walls.
At Castle Black, word comes that the mutineers are camped at Craster's Keep, and Jon argues for attacking them.

episodes.title: Oathkeeper
probes: Olenna and Margaery talk in the gardens as the old woman makes ready to leave the capital.
Cersei, wine in hand, insists to Jaime that Tyrion is guilty while he argues otherwise.

episodes.title: First of His Name
probes: The Hound watches Arya practising her water dancing and sneers at everything her old sword teacher taught her.
On the road, Brienne finds that her new squire has no idea how to do basic squire's work.
At the Eyrie, Sansa's aunt talks of matching her with her own son, a sulky, emotionally immature boy.

episodes.title: The Laws of Gods and Men
probes: In Meereen, a goatherd stands before Daenerys's court complaining that her dragons burned his flock.
A wealthy Meereenese man petitions Daenerys for permission to take down and bury his crucified father.
Davos and Stannis sit across a long table from bankers in Braavos, arguing their case for a loan.

episodes.title: Mockingbird
probes: At a roadside inn, Brienne and Podrick come across Hot Pie, who chatters away about his cooking.
With the Wildling host drawing near, Jon argues that the tunnel under the Wall should be sealed up.
Daenerys dispatches Daario to deal with the slavers who have regained their footing in Yunkai.
Melisandre and Selyse make preparations to sail away from Dragonstone, intending to bring Shireen with them.

episodes.title: The Mountain and the Viper
probes: In Meereen, Grey Worm and Missandei find themselves quietly growing closer.
A crowd fills an open courtyard in King's Landing as the trial by combat is about to begin.
The Hound and Arya ride up to the gatehouse at the foot of the road to the Eyrie.

episodes.title: The Watchers on the Wall
probes: The brothers of the Night's Watch spend the night readying Castle Black's gate and the top of the Wall.
Climbers hack their way up the sheer ice in darkness while defenders peer down from the Wall's edge.

episodes.title: The Wars to Come
probes: Missandei asks Grey Worm why some of the Unsullied still pay visits to brothels.
Tyrion, drunk and miserable, is cooped up in a Pentos manse with Varys before they set out east.
Littlefinger leaves young Robin in the keeping of a Vale lord before he and Sansa ride away.

episodes.title: The House of Black and White
probes: Newly arrived in Braavos, Arya makes her way to a building the locals call the House of Black and White.
Littlefinger and Sansa break their journey at a crowded roadside tavern, where other travellers are eating and drinking.
Brienne and Podrick ride off on their own again, keeping their distance behind another party on the road.

episodes.title: High Sparrow
probes: Brienne puts Podrick through sword drills, correcting his grip and stance as they travel.
Arya throws her clothes and belongings into the Braavosi harbour, but slips Needle into a hiding place among rocks.

episodes.title: Sons of the Harpy
probes: Melisandre comes to Jon at Castle Black and tries to seduce him into riding south with Stannis.
Jaime and Bronn come ashore secretly on the Dornish coast, there to retrieve Myrcella without anyone's knowledge.
Hizdahr zo Loraq presses Daenerys once again to reopen Meereen's fighting pits as an old local tradition.

episodes.title: Kill the Boy
probes: Tyrion and Jorah sail in a small boat through the drowned ruins of Valyria, a dragon passing overhead.
Brienne and Podrick take a room at an inn within sight of Winterfell and quietly get word inside.
Stannis breaks camp at the Wall, his army marching out with his family and the red priestess in tow.

episodes.title: Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken
probes: Jaime and Bronn move quietly through the pools and terraces of the Dornish Water Gardens.
Olenna arrives in King's Landing and sits down with Cersei to talk bluntly about the Tyrell alliance.

episodes.title: The Gift
probes: Daenerys and her consort walk the empty sands of the great fighting pit, inspecting it ahead of the games.

episodes.title: Hardhome
probes: Disguised as a peddler wheeling a cart of shellfish through Braavos, Arya watches a man who sells insurance to shipowners.
Jon and Tormund stand before a crowd of Wildlings in a bleak seaside settlement, arguing for passage south.

episodes.title: The Dance of Dragons
probes: Mace Tyrell has come to Braavos to negotiate with the Iron Bank on the crown's behalf.
Daenerys takes her seat above Daznak's pit as the fighting resumes before a packed crowd.
Stannis dispatches Davos back to Castle Black to request more supplies for the snowbound camp.

episodes.title: Mother's Mercy
probes: Samwell asks to be sent south to Oldtown to train as a maester, taking Gilly and the baby with him.

episodes.title: The Red Woman
probes: In Braavos, blinded Arya begs on the street; each day a young woman beats her with a staff.
Jorah and Daario are still out in the grasslands, following the trail left behind by Daenerys.
Davos and a handful of loyalists bolt themselves inside a room at Castle Black with Jon's body.

episodes.title: Home
probes: Tyrion, carrying a torch, edges into the dark catacombs beneath Meereen to speak with the two chained dragons.
Tommen comes to his mother and admits he needs her help to be strong.

episodes.title: Oathbreaker
probes: Cersei and Jaime walk uninvited into a small council meeting, her towering silent bodyguard standing behind them.
In King's Landing, the High Sparrow takes the young king aside and preaches to him at length.
Aboard a ship heading south, Sam tells Gilly he means to leave her and the baby with his family.

episodes.title: Book of the Stranger
probes: Margaery is escorted down to Loras's cell and allowed a brief visit with her brother.

episodes.title: The Door
probes: In Braavos, Arya is given a new target: an actress with a travelling theatre company.
On the shore of the Iron Islands, the ironborn assemble for a kingsmoot to choose Balon's successor.
In Meereen, Tyrion and Varys receive a red priestess who has travelled to preach on Daenerys's behalf.

episodes.title: Blood of My Blood
probes: At Horn Hill, Sam's father demeans him at the table as a soft bookworm and insults Gilly for being a Wildling.
Meera hauls Bran through the snow on a sled while he lies lost in a flood of visions.

episodes.title: The Broken Man
probes: Jaime and Bronn ride into the muddy siege camp outside Riverrun, where Jaime takes charge of the besieging forces.
Theon and Yara spend a last night ashore in Volantis with their crew before their ships sail on.
Jon, Sansa and Davos travel from hall to hall in the North, asking house after house for fighting men.

episodes.title: No One
probes: Varys says his farewells in Meereen and takes ship, staying vague with Tyrion about his errand.
Brienne is admitted into Riverrun to sit down with Sansa's grizzled great-uncle and argue for the castle.

episodes.title: Battle of the Bastards
probes: Outside Winterfell, the Stark and Bolton armies form up facing each other across a wide open field.
In Meereen, Daenerys and Tyrion sit across from three masters of the slaving cities, trying to talk terms.
Theon and Yara stand before Daenerys and Tyrion in Meereen, asking that the Iron Islands be left independent.

episodes.title: The Winds of Winter
probes: Samwell and Gilly, with Little Sam, finally reach the Citadel in Oldtown after their long journey south.
Bran and Meera travel with Benjen as far as the Wall, where he stops and goes no further.

episodes.title: Dragonstone
probes: Arya shares a fireside meal and drink with a group of young Lannister soldiers in the Riverlands.
Edd opens the gate at Castle Black to receive Bran and Meera, arrived out of the snow.
In Winterfell's hall, Sansa contradicts Jon in front of everyone over the young Umber and Karstark heirs.

episodes.title: Stormborn
probes: At a roadside inn, Arya is served stew by an old friend from her travels who bakes bread.
Daenerys presses Varys about the many masters he has served, and he answers her before the whole room.
Daenerys and her assembled allies plan their campaign standing around the great carved map table at Dragonstone.

episodes.title: The Spoils of War
probes: Cersei receives a banker from Braavos and assures him the crown's enormous debt will soon be repaid in full.
Littlefinger presents Bran with a slim Valyrian steel dagger with a dragonbone hilt as a gift.
Deep in a dragonglass cave, Jon lifts a torch to show Daenerys ancient spiral carvings left by the Children of the Forest.
Meera prepares for the journey home, and Bran's farewell to her is flat and strangely unfeeling.

episodes.title: Eastwatch
probes: Jorah arrives at Dragonstone and presents himself once more before Daenerys, fully recovered.

episodes.title: The Dragon and the Wolf
probes: The rival camps gather for a parley in a ruined pit on the edge of King's Landing.
On the shore at Dragonstone, Theon stands before the last of his ironborn men.

episodes.title: Winterfell
probes: Jon and Daenerys take the dragons up together, flying over the North and landing alone in the snow.
The combined armies march into Winterfell while wary Northerners line the road watching the Dothraki and Unsullied pass.
Jon and Arya see each other again for the first time in years, comparing their swords.

episodes.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
probes: Sam presents Jorah with House Tarly's ancestral Valyrian sword before the battle, insisting he take it.
Daenerys sits with Sansa and tries to win her trust by invoking their mutual love for Jon.
Jorah tries to talk young Lyanna Mormont out of taking part in the fighting.

episodes.title: The Long Night
probes: Jon and Daenerys fight from dragonback high above the snow, hunting a rider through the night sky.

episodes.title: The Last of the Starks
probes: During the feast Daenerys rises and grants Gendry a lordship and the seat of Storm's End.

episodes.title: The Bells
probes: Arya and the Hound arrive at King's Landing and work their way inside the crowded city, hoods up.
Three separate travellers slip into King's Landing unnoticed, each with private business in the capital.
